edges: Princess Petulant waits for Martin to return with her toy but eventually becomes upset.
A pine dwarf promises to bring Princess Petulant to the waterfall to show her the way to Martin.
Princess Petulant finally makes it to Martin without speaking a single word.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Martin and Princess Petulant play with the best toys they have ever seen, satisfying the Princess’ desire for a new toy.
Martin encounters Bobolink, the Purple Enchanter, who knows everything.
Martin becomes distracted and engages in conversation with a fish, which traps him in the country of conversation.

edges: Princess Petulant is the spoiled daughter of the King, who is also her uncle.
